text_block_list.text:
Invited as thanks for the refreshment,
I attended Curren Chan's fan meeting...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Welcome to "Curren for U♡", everyone!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Today's theme is "Returning the Love"...
Be sure to take all of Curren's love home with you, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaa! You're so cute, Curren Chan!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Now then, count down to Curren Chan's "I hate you!"—
3... 2... 1...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "...Geez, I hate you so much."

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Uoooh! So cute, Curren Chan...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, was that the kind of "I hate you" you were expecting~?
...Well then, let's hear the next line, please♪

The fan meeting proceeded smoothly like this,
and as it neared its conclusion—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Lastly, Curren has a surprise for you all!
...I have to get ready, so close your eyes and wait, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, what surprise?
—My heart can't take any more fan-service...!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Alright! You can look now♪

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (Murmurs ripple through the crowd!)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
—A piano, for real!?
—Wait, what is she playing? Can she even play!?
—Curren Chan is so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
My surprise is a piano performance from Curren♪
Well, were you surprised~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But the real show starts now.
I'm going to surprise you way, waaaay more, so—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Don't take your eyes off Curren, okay?
(—♪ Plink, plink!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: ! Th-This song... No way...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: ~~!! Curren Chan, you're way too amazing...! That's right, Curren Chan is so cool and—

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Her aiming for the fastest speed is what makes her the absolute "Cutest"!

Everyone was so captivated that no one was even waving their penlights.
That was just how incredible Curren Chan's performance was.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Ahh, adorable Curren Chan... I love you so much...!

When the event ended and cleanup was underway,
an event feedback survey caught my eye.
Taking one of the survey sheets in hand—
choice_data_list: Write "Please let us hear you play the piano again."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, did you become Curren's fan?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding.
That answer on your survey is more than enough♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Please come to the next fan meeting too if you'd like, okay?
—I'll show you an even more super-cute Curren♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad!
It looks like you really enjoyed it♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind playing the piano again, you know?
However, when that time comes—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Give Curren enough love...
to rival that performance, okay?
